infoLinks.urlText:
Bank Street Light Rail Lift between Miller St and the Light Rail stop is not available

‎
infoLinks.content:
At Bank Street Light Rail Lift between Miller St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
For your safety, do not use even if doors open.
 
Alternative access:
Use the stairs, if able to
Or use the opposite accessible entry/exit ramp via Bank Street.
For urgent assistance:
Use the Help Point if on the platform
Or call 131 500
